subject: Daze Ring
text: A Daze Ring is found inside a room in Treck Cave.

evidence.quote: Enter, and walk down the steps. Go down, avoiding the poisonous mud, and take the Daze Ring inside the room.

subject: Goblins
text: A party level of Level 8 is recommended when facing the three goblins outside Treck Cave.

evidence.quote: As you're about to board the ship, you're attacked again, this time by three goblins! I seriously suggest having all your characters at Level 8 by this battle, because these guys are even more annoying than the Demonlords.

subject: Goblins
text: The goblins inflict 13-16 HP of damage per hit and can deal around 50 damage when focusing attacks on one target.

evidence.quote: These guys do a MASSIVE amount of damage with each hit, around 13-16 HP per attack. When they gang up on someone, they can sometimes end up doing about 50 damage.

subject: Goblins
text: The goblins possess roughly 130-140 HP each, and Lufia's Dew spell is effective against all of them.

evidence.quote: Lufia's Flash spell is still effective in this battle, but Dew is even better, because it attacks all of them. The worst part about these goblins, besides the fact that they have around 130-140 HP, is that they're sickeningly fast.

subject: Sweet Water
text: A Sweet Water can be picked up on the second floor of the shop building in Lorbenia.

evidence.quote: Take the Sweet Water on the second floor, but there's not much else but a crappy jewelry shop and a worthless stuffed animal shop.

subject: Treasure Hunters Guild
text: Paying 50 Gold is required to enter the basement treasure hunters guild in Grenoble.

evidence.quote: Now, pay that jerk 50 Gold to go down into the basement. You'll find a treasure hunter guild of sorts.

subject: Secret Map
text: The task for the Secret Map pays a reward of 500 Gold in Grenoble.

evidence.quote: Before you leave, also enlist for the 500 Gold task of the Secret Map.

subject: Ex Potion
text: An Ex Potion is hidden in the muck about three steps below the empty chest on the 2nd Level of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: If you head straight down, in the big pile of muck, about three steps below the empty chest, there is an Ex Potion hidden.

subject: Power Ring
text: A Power Ring is obtained inside the door past the muck on the 2nd Level of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Enter the door for the Power Ring and the Secret Map.

subject: Secret Map
text: The Secret Map is located inside the room entered near the muck on the 2nd Level of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Enter the door for the Power Ring and the Secret Map. Go back up and head left this time, then continue downwards to the two chests in the muck.

subject: Tan Shield
text: A Tan Shield is contained in one of the two chests situated in the muck on the 2nd Level of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Go back up and head left this time, then continue downwards to the two chests in the muck. Take them for a Tan Shield and a Dragon Egg.

subject: Dragon Egg
text: A Dragon Egg is found in one of the two chests in the muck on the 2nd Level of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Go back up and head left this time, then continue downwards to the two chests in the muck. Take them for a Tan Shield and a Dragon Egg.

subject: Fairy Kiss
text: The Fairy Kiss is acquired inside the room on the 2nd Level of Old Cave that only women can enter.

evidence.quote: Go back up and you'll reach the room that only women can enter. Walk Lufia through, running from most of the battles, and then take all the treasure and leave... Once you have the Fairy Kiss, you can head back to Grenoble.

subject: Cloth Shoes
text: Cloth Shoes increase Defense by 2, whereas Heeled shoes increase Attack by 5.

evidence.quote: The Cloth Shoes raise her Defense by 2, but the Heeled shoes raise her attack by 5.

subject: Sonic Ring
text: A Sonic Ring is located inside the room to the immediate left upon entering Northwest Tower.

evidence.quote: As soon as you enter, go to your immediate left, and enter the room. Keep going and take the Sonic Ring.

subject: Smoke Ball
text: A Smoke Ball is found after heading up the steps in Northwest Tower.

evidence.quote: Head up the steps and take the Smoke Ball.

subject: Kobold
text: Kobolds drop Mid Arrows when defeated in battle.

evidence.quote: Hopefully you have at least 10. Kobolds drop them when you fight.

subject: Artea's Apprentice
text: Artea's apprentice has about 300 HP and begins the duel by casting Fake on himself to attack twice per turn.

evidence.quote: This bad boy has about 300 HP, and he begins by casting Fake on himself, allowing him to attack twice per turn. Greaaat. And you get to fight him one on one.

subject: Artea's Apprentice
text: Defeating Artea's apprentice rewards the player with a Speed Potion and reveals Artea's location.

evidence.quote: Afterwards, he'll tell you where Artea is, and give you a Speed Potion.

subject: Mid Arrow
text: Two Mid Arrows are located around the apprentice's room on the fourth floor of Northwest Tower.

evidence.quote: Leave the room, and then head back around it, snag the two Mid Arrows, and hop out of the tower.

subject: Silver Wick
text: Taking up the Silver Wick task in the Treasure Guild in Grenoble offers a 1000 Gold prize.

evidence.quote: Head back to Grenoble anyway, and in the Treasure Guild, take up the task to get the Silver Wick for 1000 Gold.

subject: Miracle
text: A Miracle is hidden in the right puddle of muck one space left and three spaces down from the Smoke Ball chest on the 3rd floor of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: In the next room, the right puddle of muck has a Miracle hidden in it one space left and three spaces down from the Smoke Ball chest.

subject: Broad Sword
text: The Broad Sword found on the 3rd floor of Old Cave raises Attack by 40, but is cursed to drain HP on every attack.

evidence.quote: Now, the Broad Sword in here raises Hero's attack by 40, the only problem is that it's cursed, and takes down a bit of his HP every time he attacks.

subject: Broad Sword
text: Lifting the curse on the Broad Sword in Grenoble costs 600 Gold and reduces the damage taken to 1-3 damage per turn.

evidence.quote: You can get the curse lifted in Grenoble for 600 Gold. This doesn't totally do away with the curse, it just subtracts it to 1-3 damage per turn.

subject: Silver Wick
text: The Silver Wick is located inside the final room on the 3rd floor of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: Enter the last room, pick up the Silver Wick, and head back to Grenoble and get your prize.

subject: Stuffed Dog
text: A Stuffed Dog can be found by searching the dressers in the bedroom of the northeast house in Kirof.

evidence.quote: Plunder the houses, and then go into the northeast house and back to the bedroom... check the two dressers for a Stuffed Dog and Pig.

subject: Stuffed Pig
text: A Stuffed Pig can be found by searching the dressers in the bedroom of the northeast house in Kirof.

evidence.quote: Plunder the houses, and then go into the northeast house and back to the bedroom... check the two dressers for a Stuffed Dog and Pig.

subject: Mace
text: The Mace available in Medan boosts Lufia's attack by about 20.

evidence.quote: What's cool here, is that Lufia gets a Mace that raises her attack about 20.
